description: Shows the subprocessor lists of 17 widely used cloud providers (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe and others) as monitored daily by frag.hugo: date of the last change, number of entries, names and links to the official list and the data processing agreement. Use it to check whether a provider changed its subprocessors since a given date. Not for providers outside these 17.

anbieter.description: Provider ID; without it all 17 monitored providers are listed

seit.description: Only providers whose subprocessor list changed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

sprache.description: Output language. Default: German if the input is German, otherwise English.

name: get_subprocessor_changes

eintraege.description: Number of entries, if the list is machine-readable

geprueft.description: Time of the last automatic check

letzte_aenderung.description: Date of the last detected change of the list

rueckfall.description: true = live export unreachable, last good copy served

title: Subprocessor changes (Subprozessor-Monitor)
